name: PR Streams
description: Telegram file-to-link bot with high-speed downloads and an in-browser streaming player (VLC / MX Player support).

STORAGE_CHANNEL.description: Private channel id (-100...) where the bot is admin

FQDN.description: Public hostname of the deployed app (no scheme, no trailing /)

HAS_SSL.description: true if the public URL is https

NO_PORT.description: true when served on default 80/443 port

PING_INTERVAL.description: Self-ping seconds to stay awake on free tiers
